title: The page-copy Stop check fires for the cloud triage session that wrote the page
why: The repo copy of the waiting page went 11 hours stale (last copy 00:27 CST Nov 11). This triage session wrote item 506 at 11:20 CST and updated it at 11:27, and no Stop blocked, though meta/page names this session as writer. Without the copy a lost page loses its items (decision waiting-data-in-repo).
